issue_context.title: Uri.IsBaseOf(bool) not true by user info
issue_context.body:
### Description

When check a Uri with same info except UserInfo, IsBaseOf method must be return true, as say in [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.uri.isbaseof?view=net-7.0) 

> When comparing two [Uri](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.uri?view=net-7.0) objects to determine a base relationship, the user information ([UserInfo](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.uri.userinfo?view=net-7.0)) is not evaluated

But this behavior does not occur in my case :(

### Reproduction Steps

```csharp
Assert.True(new Uri("https://user@domain.com").IsBaseOf(new("https://domain.com")));
```



### Expected behavior

Return true

### Actual behavior

Return false

### Regression?

_No response_

### Known Workarounds

_No response_

_No response_

I can reproduce it even with 2 different UserInfos:
```c#
Console.WriteLine(new Uri("https://user@domain.com").IsBaseOf(new("https://user2@domain.com"))); // Returns False
```

It also reproduces on .NET Framework 4.8, so not a regression, or blocker for migration.
I think it is a bug and should behave as documentation suggests. Moving to Future.

Looking at the implementation, it's clear that `UserInfo` isn't being ignored at all.
The change to do so should be pretty straightforward (probably just tweak which components we look at), assuming we want to make it.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/4e48d2d85ed15140b95323e615a5433726b583b2/src/libraries/System.Private.Uri/src/System/UriExt.cs#L894-L905
